about.title: A frontend developer who ships.
about.bio: I'm a frontend developer who has independently built and deployed 5 full-featured web applications using React.js and Node.js. I'm currently studying Information Systems and Technologies (evening program) at the National University of Uzbekistan, and completed the React.js course at Mohirdev. I have hands-on experience with the MERN stack and server configuration (Linux, Nginx, PM2).
